description: No charge. Read up to 50 postcard emails in the owning workspace, newest first. Pass nextCursor as before for older records. Returns attachment names/indexes, artworkPreparation status/error, review state and the current user's saved quote summary; no private storage paths. Requires workspace authentication and OAuth mcp:read permission. No polling or mailing.
name: list_email_postcards
title: List Email Postcards
